note: Ground-floor seasons room. Feminine nouns on the left (l'année, la fête, la saison, l'échéance), the two adjectives (mensuel, saisonnier) in the middle, masculine on the right (l'an, l'été, l'hiver, le printemps, mai, juillet, octobre). The archway on the far left goes back to the entrance hall; the wooden door on the right leads to the weeks room. Zoom: the little writing desk at the front left.
